_readme: Dock season status for water.html#docks. Edit here, then run: python3 tools/build-docks.py && python3 tools/stamp-version.py. Status is one of: in, ending, out, unannounced. 'ending' needs 'ends' (YYYY-MM-DD) and flips to 'after' text on the page once that date passes. Never set 'out' without an official source saying so. 'checked' is the date someone last read every source below. tools/check-docks.py watches the 'watch' list.

hoover.name: Hoover

items.name: City marina docks
items.label: Season ends Oct. 31
items.note: Columbus Recreation and Parks lists the public dock season at its Griggs, Hoover and O’Shaughnessy marinas as May 1 to Oct. 31.
items.after_note: Columbus Recreation and Parks lists the public dock season as May 1 to Oct. 31, so the next season starts May 1.

items.name: Ramp docks
items.label: Not announced
items.note: Columbus has not posted a 2026 date for pulling the docks at the public ramps. No closure for Hoover is on the city’s alerts page.

calls: Hoover dock office (Columbus Rec and Parks)

items.name: State park docks
items.label: Not announced
items.note: ODNR has not posted a 2026 date for pulling the lease or launch docks.

items.name: Winter drawdown
items.label: 2026 not posted
items.note: ODNR’s drawdown list still shows last winter: 3 ft, Oct. 1 to Nov. 1, 2025, for flood control, refilled Mar. 15 to Apr. 15, 2026. The Corps of Engineers sets the timing.

items.name: Alum Creek Marina
items.label: October weekends
items.note: The marina lists April and October hours as Saturday and Sunday only, 9 am to 6 pm. Its 12 overnight slips take stays of up to 4 days.
items.after_note: The marina lists hours for April to October only. Call before you go.

items.note: ODNR’s drawdown list still shows last winter: 3 ft, Nov. 15 to Dec. 15, 2025, for dock maintenance, seawall repair and shoreline work, refilled Mar. 1 to May 1, 2026.

items.name: Marina
items.label: Off season calls
items.note: ODNR says the marina is open seasonally, with rentals, overnight docks and fuel. From October to April, call the camp office.

items.label: Seasonal, Corps timing
items.note: ODNR’s drawdown list shows 14 ft, from the 810 ft standard pool to a 796 ft winter pool, Oct. 1 to Nov. 30, refilled Apr. 1 to May 15. The Corps of Engineers sets the timing. Check the Corps lake level before a trip.

items.label: Not posted

items.note: ODNR’s drawdown list still shows last season’s dates (2025–26): 3 ft, from the 737 ft pool to 734 ft, Nov. 1 to Dec. 1, refilled Apr. 1 to Apr. 15, for flood control. Last year the Corps of Engineers pushed the start past Dec. 1. The Corps sets the timing; check the Corps lake level before a trip.
